quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: It was never my destiny to stop you. I have set another on that path.
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: Who are you? ... I've been asking the same question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? Turns out, I'm all of them.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: No, they don't. Wounds heal. I don't care what scars do!
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: I'm not a big fat panda. I'm THE big fat panda.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: If you only do what you can do, you will never be more than you are now.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: Now, who wants to do the right thing for the wrong reasons?
quotes.author: Zhen

quotes.text: My time has come. You must now continue your journey without me. You must believe...
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: I've been asking myself that question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? I'm all of those things. I am the Dragon Warrior!
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: The secret ingredient is... nothing! To make something special you just have to believe it's special.
quotes.author: Mr. Ping
